messages:
anil: quick status — spun up a tiny rig to try the 'beamless' sampler on a 13B quant-4 build (llama3-mini fork). ran 2k prompts from the new onboarding suite, baseline greedy avg ~48ms/token, beamless speculative avg ~31ms/token. quality: mixed — most dialogs fine but ~2.6% of instruction-following tests show hallucination spikes. attaching the short log and an example.

maya: awesome throughput win. did you freeze seeds / temp for the run? was batching identical?

anil: yes kept temp=0.7, seed=42, batch=8 (same as baseline run). used the usual prefix cache. measurement script: `python infra/bench/run_trace.py --suite onboarding_v2 --runs 2000 --batch 8 --seed 42`

ops-bot: job/beamless-rig-1739 completed on dedicated-pool-3 (nodes: g5x8) — artifacts: s3://redwood-test/beamless/1739004820/* :thumbsup:

lisa: pasted one of the failing examples below — short instruction about summarization and it invents a non-existent metric ("throughput index"). seems like a calibration shift, maybe from quantization + spec decisions interacting with logits scaling.

lisa: ```
prompt: "Summarize the attached report focusing on key performance indexes."
response (baseline greedy): "Key performance indexes: latency, throughput, error rate."
response (beamless): "Key performance indexes: latency, throughput, error rate, throughput index (a proprietary metric)."
```

peer-reviewer: interesting. request: run ablations for (A) prefex/KV cache on vs off, (B) quant-4 vs quant-3, (C) speculative window sizes 8/16/32. stratify results by prompt length buckets (<=32, 33-128, >128). also compute BERTScore and a small edit-distance-based hallucination flag we use in evals.

anil: good plan. i'll queue the matrix: 3x2x3 = 18 permutations, 500 prompts each stratified across lengths. should finish ~3-4 hours on the rig. will include deterministic seeds and full token logs.

maya: also add the safety holdout set (the one from /evals/safety/holdouts/2025-02) — hallucination spike might correlate with rare phrasing.

anil: noted. will run with and without safety holdout. quick sanity check: any objections to keeping the speculative early-exit threshold at 0.9 for this sweep?

peer-reviewer: 0.9 is fine for initial pass. add a secondary run at 0.95 for the short-length bucket only.

lisa: one small ask — when you capture outputs, include `logprobs` for the first 16 tokens and top-3 alternatives. helps see whether the sampler is overconfident on invented tokens.

anil: will do. tagging @maya in the run ticket for visibility. starting the ablation now. will post a short summary + small diffed examples when done. :rocket:

maya: thx — if we see consistent hallucination mode, maybe try a quick temperature sweep 0.0 -> 0.8 to see if it's temperature-sensitive.

anil: ack, adding that as contingency. will update here when jobs finish.
